extension.displayName: AI Git Message - Smart Commit Generator
extension.description: Generate high-quality Git commit messages with AI right from the VS Code Source Control view. Supports multiple commit templates, OpenAI Responses & Anthropic Messages protocols, and automatic model discovery.
command.generateWithTemplate: Generate Commit Message with Selected Template...
command.addProvider: Add AI Provider (OpenAI Response / Anthropic Message)
command.openDashboard: Open AI Git Message Settings Center
config.title: AI Git Message
config.activeTemplateId: Default Git commit message template ID
config.commitLanguage: Output language for generated Git commit messages
config.askTemplateBeforeGenerate: Prompt to select a template every time the Generate button is clicked
config.diffScope: Git diff scope analyzed when generating commit messages
config.diffScope.auto: Smart Auto: Use Staged Changes if available, otherwise use Working Tree changes
config.diffScope.staged: Staged Only: Only analyze staged changes (git diff --cached)
config.diffScope.all: All Changes: Analyze both staged and unstaged changes
config.streamOutput: Stream the generated commit message into the SCM input box in real time
config.maxDiffLines: Maximum diff lines sent to AI
config.customInstructions: Global custom instructions appended to all templates
config.showStatusBar: Show AI model & template quick switcher in the status bar
config.providers: Configured AI model providers (API keys are stored securely in VS Code SecretStorage)
config.customTemplates: User-defined custom Git commit message templates
